Philips TWS Earbuds – TAT1269 with Mic, 13mm Drivers, Bluetooth 5.4

Experience powerful sound, long-lasting comfort, and advanced wireless performance with the Philips TWS Earbuds – TAT1269. Designed for music lovers, gamers, and professionals, these true wireless earbuds combine 13mm dynamic drivers, Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity, and an impressive 40 hours of total playtime to deliver an uninterrupted listening experience.

The Philips TWS Earbuds – TAT1269 with mic deliver deep bass, clear vocals, and balanced audio, making them ideal for calls, workouts, and daily entertainment. With IPX5 water resistance, fast charging support, and intuitive touch controls, these earbuds are built for an active lifestyle.

Powerful Sound with 13mm Drivers

Enjoy immersive audio powered by large 13mm drivers that produce punchy bass and crisp highs. Whether you’re streaming music, watching videos, or attending virtual meetings, the Philips TWS Earbuds – TAT1269 ensure rich sound clarity across all frequencies.

Advanced Bluetooth 5.4 Connectivity

Equipped with the latest Bluetooth 5.4 technology, these offer faster pairing, lower latency, and a stable wireless connection. Seamlessly connect to smartphones, tablets, laptops, and other Bluetooth-enabled devices with minimal signal drops.

Up to 40 Hours Playtime with Fast Charging

Never worry about running out of battery. The provide up to 40 hours of total playtime including the charging case. With fast charging, a quick charge gives you hours of playback, perfect for users on the go.

Clear Calls with Built-in Mic & Voice Assistant

The built-in high-quality microphone ensures clear voice transmission during calls and online meetings. These also support popular voice assistants, allowing hands-free control for calls, music, and smart device functions.

IPX5 Water Resistance for Active Use

Designed to handle sweat and splashes, the IPX5-rated are ideal for workouts, running, and outdoor activities. Stay confident and focused even during intense sessions.

Smart Touch Controls & Comfortable Fit

Manage your music, calls, and voice assistant effortlessly with intuitive touch controls. The ergonomic design ensures a secure and comfortable fit for extended listening sessions.
